summary: This note is a short biographical entry on Andrea von Habsburg, an Archduchess of Austria and Hereditary Countess of Neipperg, born 30 May 1953 in Würzburg, Bavaria. It identifies her as the first child and oldest daughter of Otto von Habsburg and Princess Regina of Saxe-Meiningen. The note gives no further details about her life.
one_line: Biographical entry on Archduchess Andrea von Habsburg, born 1953 in Würzburg, eldest daughter of Otto von Habsburg.
key_facts: Andrea von Habsburg's full name is given as Andrea Maria von Habsburg-Lothringen.
Andrea von Habsburg holds the titles Archduchess of Austria and Hereditary Countess of Neipperg.
Andrea von Habsburg was born on 30 May 1953.
Andrea von Habsburg was born in Würzburg, Bavaria.
Andrea von Habsburg is the first child of Otto von Habsburg and his wife, Princess Regina of Saxe-Meiningen.
Andrea von Habsburg is the oldest daughter of Otto von Habsburg.
